title.zh: 将帕拉尼亚克市 Marcelo Green 描笼涯的 Parañaque 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Marcelo Green 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Parañaque National High School - Marcelo Green Annex in Barangay Marcelo Green, Parañaque City, Metro Manila from the Parañaque National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to Be Known as The Marcelo Green National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Parañaque National High School - Marcelo Green Annex in Barangay Marcelo Green, Parañaque City, Metro Manila from the Parañaque National High School, Converting It into an Independent National High School to Be Known as The Marcelo Green National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Marcelo Green của Trường Trung học Parañaque Quốc gia tại Barangay Marcelo Green, Thành phố Parañaque, Vùng Metro Manila khỏi Trường Trung học Parañaque Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Marcelo Green Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Marcelo Green ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Parañaque แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Marcelo Green เมือง Parañaque เขตมหานครมะนิลาออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Parañaque แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Marcelo Green แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Marcelo Green, Sekolah Menengah Parañaque Nasional di Barangay Marcelo Green, Kota Parañaque, Wilayah Metropolitan Manila dari Sekolah Menengah Parañaque Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Marcelo Green Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana

text.en: The Parañaque National High School – Marcelo Green Annex in Barangay Marcelo Green, Parañaque City, Metro Manila is hereby separated from the Parañaque National High School and converted in into an independent national high school to be known as the Marcelo Green National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Parañaque National High School – Marcelo Green Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Marcelo Green National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Marcelo Green National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Parañaque National High School – Marcelo Green Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Within sixty (60) days after the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall promulgate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
